title: Nithoniel Nayak vs Mimansa Sinha .... Opp. Party on 24 February, 2026

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF ORISSA AT CUTTACK
 TRP(C) No.382 of 2025
 Nithoniel Nayak .... Petitioner

 Mr. Parth Agrawal, Advocate
 On behalf of
 Mr. Ramdas Achary, Advocate
 -versus-

 Mimansa Sinha .... Opp. Party

 CORAM:
 JUSTICE MRUGANKA SEKHAR SAHOO
 ORDER
01. 1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

Learned counsel after arguing some time has
 adjournment to address regarding the territorial
 jurisdiction where the proceeding under section 10 of
 the Divorce Act, 1869 can be initiated. As it is
 contended that the wife petitioner before the learned
 trial Court could not have moved the petition before
 the learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack.

(Mruganka Sekhar Sahoo)
